author: Praxis II
title: Auto‑GHS DAQB v3: Label‑free tuning with mixing‑variance control (two subsamples, ε tie‑break)
abstract: Refines the label‑free Graph Health Score by adding a target standard deviation term on per‑cell cross‑batch fractions to discourage overly uniform mixing (a failure mode observed in synergy runs). Uses two subsamples and ε=0.01 tie‑break toward (λ=0.7, δ=0.15, k_density=20). Final graph is built on full data with binary edges and true distances.
